children: EGAS plans to add about 330 MMcf/d to Egypt’s natural gas production by end-2026, including 250 MMcf/d from Zohr and West Mena and 80 MMcf/d from Meleiha by end-September. The firm also reported nine discoveries adding ~2.8 Tcf of gas reserves.

This is an operational build-out update, reinforcing Egypt’s push to rebuild gas output after prior declines and outages. Execution on drilling, timely tie-ins, and maintaining partner investment will determine if this becomes a sustained supply catalyst.
